import math

# Nominal unmatured redemptions (in millions)
jan_1970 = 284  # million
feb_1970 = 295  # million
mar_1970 = 375  # million

# CPI-U values (1982-84=100)
# Using linear interpolation between 1969 (36.7) and 1970 (38.8)
# Assuming monthly progression
cpi_1969 = 36.7
cpi_1970 = 38.8

# Monthly CPI estimates (linear interpolation)
# Months 1-12 go from cpi_1969 to cpi_1970
# Jan 1970 = 36.7 + (1/12)*(38.8-36.7) = 36.7 + 0.175 = 36.875
# Feb 1970 = 36.7 + (2/12)*(38.8-36.7) = 36.7 + 0.35 = 37.05
# Mar 1970 = 36.7 + (3/12)*(38.8-36.7) = 36.7 + 0.525 = 37.225
cpi_jan_1970 = cpi_1969 + (1/12) * (cpi_1970 - cpi_1969)
cpi_feb_1970 = cpi_1969 + (2/12) * (cpi_1970 - cpi_1969)
cpi_mar_1970 = cpi_1969 + (3/12) * (cpi_1970 - cpi_1969)

# March 1970 CPI is the target
cpi_mar = cpi_mar_1970  # 37.225

# Convert to real March 1970 dollars
real_jan = jan_1970 * (cpi_mar / cpi_jan_1970)
real_feb = feb_1970 * (cpi_mar / cpi_feb_1970)
real_mar = mar_1970 * (cpi_mar / cpi_mar_1970)

print(f"CPI Jan 1970: {cpi_jan_1970}")
print(f"CPI Feb 1970: {cpi_feb_1970}")
print(f"CPI Mar 1970: {cpi_mar_1970}")
print(f"\nReal Jan 1970: {real_jan}")
print(f"Real Feb 1970: {real_feb}")
print(f"Real Mar 1970: {real_mar}")

# Now compute linear regression: y = slope * x + intercept
# x = month number (1, 2, 3)
# y = real values

x = [1, 2, 3]
y = [real_jan, real_feb, real_mar]

n = len(x)
xbar = sum(x) / n
ybar = sum(y) / n

# OLS slope = sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)^2)
numerator = sum((x[i] - xbar) * (y[i] - ybar) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((x[i] - xbar) ** 2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"\nLinear regression:")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")
print(f"\nFormatted [slope, intercept]: [{round(slope, 2)}, {round(intercept, 2)}]")
